blocks.text: Sugar Loaf and a sightseeing tour of Rio

provenance.rationale: Summarise the two confirmed activities in Word day 2 as the corresponding itinerary heading.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will head to Sugar Loaf.

The route begins at Red Beach. The cable car first takes you up Urca Hill, where there is a viewing platform, cafés and bars.

The second cable car takes you to Sugar Loaf. From the summit, you can see Copacabana, Ipanema, Guanabara Bay, the Niterói Bridge and Corcovado with the statue of Christ the Redeemer.

After the descent, the sightseeing tour of Rio begins. You will drive through the central districts and see buildings from the colonial period. A visit to the Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Sebastian and a stop at the Selarón Steps may be included.
